desc: A popular knife with Military and Law Enforcement Personnel, and Fire and Rescue crews as well as civilians, our Recon 1 series continues to set the standard for Tactical Folding Knives. These dependable knives have a hard earned reputation for reliability and strength. Every model in this diverse series features our world renowned Tri-Ad lock, keeping your precious fingers safe from harm when using your knife in even the most taxing conditions. From the sturdy little workhorse that is our Micro series to the beastly cutting power of our XL Recon 1 series and all the knives in between- whatever your mission, the Recon 1 is there for you!
